name: Flagify Free
free_limit: 2 projects/workspace; unlimited flags; 3 environments; 3 seats; 75,000 evaluations/month; 50 AI messages/month
watch_out: Ongoing Free ($0, no card) is limited to one workspace, two projects, three environments, three seats, 75,000 evaluations/month and 50 AI messages/month. Higher quotas, audit logs, RBAC and full API access belong to paid plans. The advertised $20 per 1M extra evaluations is an additional paid-usage rate, not an included Free allowance; confirm overage enforcement before relying on a hard stop.
